conflicts.topic: Gestational Diabetes Carbohydrate Guidance (Ceilings vs Individualized Floor)
conflicts.explanation: DOC-GEST-001 enforces a rigid ceiling of max 30g carbohydrates per meal (failing the 175g/day pregnancy RDA), whereas DOC-GEST-002 specifies individualized carbohydrate distribution with a minimum daily floor of >= 175g/day (ADA 2026 / IOM standard) without fixed per-meal ceilings. While CONF-001 is open, both documents are locked from patient distribution until Clinical Director resolution.
